reason: I only hire people a mate or another local owner has used, and this lot is in Kuwait with no clients or reviews at all. Pay-on-approval is nice, but nobody I know can vouch for them, so I'm not handing my business over.
objection: No one I know has used them and there's nothing to show they've done this before. If it goes wrong I can't pop round to sort it out, and I don't have time for calls and back-and-forth across time zones.
would_change_my_mind: Another Manchester owner I know telling me they built their site and it was painless, done mostly over WhatsApp without a load of calls.
